short.en: Every piece has its own cost

t.zh: 常见的词便宜，生僻的词贵：词典里每个词标着一个代价。切法的代价是每一块加起来，挑最省的切法。
t.en: Common words are cheap and rare ones dear: every word in the dictionary has a cost. A way of cutting costs the sum of its pieces; find the cheapest.

t.zh: 块数最少的切法，不一定最省。
t.en: The way with the fewest pieces is not always the cheapest.

goal.zh: 算出每串字母最省的切法要花多少代价。
goal.en: Work out what the cheapest way to cut each string costs.

how.zh: 词典和代价写在测试旁边。
how.en: The dictionary and its costs are shown next to the tests.

hints.zh: 和<level-ref to="wordbreak"></level-ref>比，变的只有每一块的代价。
hints.en: Compared with <level-ref to="wordbreak"></level-ref>, only each piece’s cost has changed.

body.zh: 在<level-ref to="wordbreak"></level-ref>里，每一块都算 1，所以数的是块数。代价一换，同一块电路板就去找最省的切法。
body.en: In <level-ref to="wordbreak"></level-ref> every piece cost 1, so it counted pieces. Change the costs, and the same board finds the cheapest cut.
